title: VisExMEM: Visual Evidence-Based Explainable Multimodal Evaluation Metric
abstract: arXiv:2610.16441v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Current image-text evaluation often relies on a global score, which gives limited insight into which semantic details are supported by the image. Explainable metrics provide rationales, but the visual evidence supporting those rationales can still be difficult to verify. We introduce VisExMEM, a reference-free evaluator that decomposes captions into atomic claims, localizes visual evidence, verifies each claim, and averages claim-level support into a global score. Explanations use the same evidence and decisions. We train Qwen3.5-based 4B and 9B models on 100K samples with multi-task SFT, counterfactual refinement, and evidence-aware GDPO. Across eight benchmarks, VisExMEM-9B achieves the highest descriptive composite among open-source evaluators in our comparison, exceeding VQAScore by 11.7 points while remaining competitive with GPT-5.6 Sol. translated_title: VisExMEM：基于视觉证据的可解释多模态评估指标
translated_abstract: 当前的图像-文本评估通常依赖于全局分数，这使人们难以了解哪些语义细节得到了图像的支持。可解释的评估指标虽然能提供理由依据，但支持这些理由的视觉证据仍然难以验证。我们提出了VisExMEM，这是一个无参考评估器，它将图像描述分解为原子性声明、定位视觉证据、验证每条声明，并将声明级别的支持度平均为全局分数。其解释使用相同的证据和决策。我们在100K样本上，通过多任务SFT、反事实细化和证据感知GDPO，训练了基于Qwen3.5的4B和9B模型。在八个基准测试中，VisExMEM-9B在我们比较的开源评估器中取得了最高的描述性综合分数，超过VQAScore 11.7分，同时与GPT-5.6 Sol保持竞争力。我们还推出了AGITA-Bench，其中包含600个人工标注的图像-文本对和8.7K条原子……
tldr: 提出VisExMEM，一个基于视觉证据的无参考可解释多模态评估指标，通过将描述分解为原子声明、定位并验证视觉证据来生成全局分数与可核验的解释，在八个基准上取得开源评估器中的最佳表现。
